messages:
AJ Patel: quick sync — acme payments wants a 2-week trial to validate streaming + tool/function calling + structured JSON outputs. they care about latency, token rotation, and SSO.
Maya Li: happy to lead security ques + SOC2 stuff. can someone drop the questionnaire link and typical time-to-provide?
presales-bot: checklist: 1) install SDK sample 2) handshake flow 3) token rotation doc 4) SSO & ip allowlist note 5) pricing ballpark
Jordan K: latency will vary by model/region. Recommend we run a small perf run on a dedicated small-GPU instance. ETA 2 days to produce numbers.
Samir Ahmed: for streaming + tool calls, here's a minimal JS example (streaming + function call + structured output):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const s = client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-compat-v1', input: 'Summarize order', functions: [{ name: 'charge', params: { amount: 'number' } }] });
for await (const chunk of s) { console.log(chunk); }
```
Samir Ahmed: structured output: we recommend the model return a top-level "result" object with {action, args}. sample schema: {"action": "charge", "args": {"amount": 125, "currency": "USD"}}
Maya Li: @LegalBot can you attach the redacted SOC2 and PCI attestations we have for presales?
LegalBot: attached: redwood-soc2-2025.pdf (redacted). Also include KMS rotation note: we support customer-managed keys and HSM integrations. :white_check_mark:
AJ Patel: pricing question — customer asked about burst pricing for Dedicated for a 30-min spike (200 qps). ballpark number?
Jordan K: ballpark: reserved baseline + burst at ~2.5x unit rate. I'll sketch three scenarios (baseline, moderate burst, full burst) and share numbers + expected latency impact.
Maya Li: security Qs also asked about key rotation / on-prem. recommend Private deployment with customer KMS for regulated data. that'll speed compliance sign-off.
Samir Ahmed: FYI edge-case: if they use streaming SSE + functioncalls, ensure their proxy preserves chunked transfer-encoding and websockets. common failure: Nginx default buffers break progressive JSON streaming — set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off;`.
AJ Patel: next steps: Maya to own security questionnaire reply; Jordan to produce perf & pricing scenarios; Samir to hand over SDK example + run quick validation with their engineer. I'll schedule a 30-min demo with them for tomorrow 10am PT. @Maya Li @Jordan K @Samir Ahmed :thumbsup:
Maya Li: :thumbsup: will start questionnaire today.
Jordan K: I'll post perf numbers here before end of day.
Samir Ahmed: will message their eng lead and validate handshake flow now.
presales-bot: follow-up reminder set for 1712432078 (48h).
